valuation.method: Forward EPS x P/E. FY2027 (ends July 2027) non-GAAP diluted EPS guidance of $4.16-$4.19 (midpoint $4.175) from the fiscal Q4 2026 release of Sept 1 2026, used as the base year. At the Nov 2027 12-month target date the market prices the next fiscal year, so the multiple is applied to FY2028 (Aug 2027-Jul 2028) EPS. Common shares and USD listing: EPS is reported in USD on the ordinary share, 1 share = 1 listing, so no FX or ADR conversion applies. Earnings release time (16:05 ET) is approximated from the usual after-close schedule; the date is from the search results.

bear.driver: Next-Generation Security ARR growth slips below the 22-23% FY27 guide and the adjusted FCF margin falls short of the 38% outlook, so growth decelerates to about 10% in FY28 and the market de-rates the platform stock.
bear.assumption: FY2028 EPS $4.60 (+10% on the $4.175 FY27 midpoint) at 55x = $253.00 (-21.5% price return)

base.driver: FY27 guidance holds: revenue $14.10-14.20bn, non-GAAP operating margin 29.5%, NGS ARR $11.075-11.175bn (+22-23%). EPS compounds about 21% into FY28 with modest buyback-driven share reduction, and the multiple stays high but compresses as growth normalizes.
base.assumption: FY2028 EPS $5.05 (+21% on the $4.175 FY27 midpoint) at 70x = $353.50 (+9.7% price return)

bull.driver: ARR beats the guide and platformization drives upside to revenue and margins, EPS grows about 32% into FY28, and the market keeps a premium multiple for durable AI-security growth.
bull.assumption: FY2028 EPS $5.50 (+32% on the $4.175 FY27 midpoint) at 85x = $467.50 (+45.1% price return)

valuation.implied_by_close: At base FY2028 EPS $5.05 the close of $322.24 implies 63.8x. The provider aggregate mean target of $398.63 (51 analysts, yfinance, Nov 13 2026) implies 78.9x base EPS, and the median $415 implies 82.2x; no named analyst targets are dated on or before the reference close, so no individually weighted target is available. Holding 70x, the aggregate mean implies FY28 EPS of about $5.69, roughly 13% above the base case.
valuation.sensitivity: One turn of P/E moves the base target by $5.05 (1.6 pp of price return). $0.10 of FY2028 EPS moves it by $7.00 (2.2 pp).
valuation.watch_metric: Next-Generation Security ARR growth against the 22-23% FY27 guide, and adjusted FCF margin against the 38.0% outlook. Both must hold to support FY28 EPS of about $5.05.
valuation.next_disclosure: Fiscal Q1 2027 results, scheduled for after the close on Nov 18 2026 (2026-11-18 16:00 ET per the aggregate earnings timestamp), guided at adjusted EPS $0.96-$0.98 and revenue $3.30-3.31bn. Those results are not in the sources read for this file and should be checked before relying on the base case.

analyst_notes: No named individual analyst call on PANW is dated on or before the Nov 13 2026 reference close in the sources accessible here: the Morgan Stanley (Sept 21, $410 from $394, Overweight), Piper Sandler (Sept 2, $410 from $345) and RBC/Oppenheimer (Sept 1-2, $475 and $450) moves name no analyst, and the named StockAnalysis calls (Cantor $425, TD Cowen $440, J.P. Morgan $384, Wells Fargo $525, KeyBanc upgrade to Buy at $380) are dated Nov 13-16 and cannot be verified as public by the close, so none is entered. The provider aggregate (51 analysts, mean $398.63, median $415, 'buy' at 1.65) sits 24% above the close, which is 78.9x our base FY28 EPS versus our 70x base; the gap is consistent with analysts assuming faster FY28 EPS growth or a higher terminal multiple, and no named calls can confirm which. Coverage is therefore labeled unavailable and no target is weighted.
